title: 7S,15R-Stereoisomer of phenylethylamino derivative of colchicine exhibits potent in-vitro and in-vivo anti-cancer activity against prostate Cancer: Assessing the impact of stereochemistry on biological activity.
authors: Reddy, Chilakala Nagarjuna; Eedara, Abhisheik Chowdary; Malik, Sumera; Mondhe, Dilip M; Bharate, Sandip B; Andugulapati, Sai Balaji
one_liner_zh: 该文研究秋水仙碱衍生物的抗癌活性与立体化学影响，涉及微管蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The non-selective toxicity of colchicine remains a major barrier to its development as an anticancer agent. Here, we report a colchicine derivative, 8l, which exhibits potent and selective antiproliferative activity in prostate cancer cells. The present study investigates the impact of stereochemistry at the C10-substituted chiral amine fragment on the biological activity. Our findings reveal that the stereochemical configuration of 8l (7S,15R diastereomer) is critical for its efficacy, showing 12.5-fold greater antiproliferative activity than its counterpart, the 7S,15S diastereomer 8z. Additionally, 8l demonstrates superior alpha-tubulin polymerization inhibition compared to 8z, that were further corroborated by docking and simulation studies. Mechanistic insights indicate that 8l increases reactive oxygen species levels by modulating the NRF-2/KEAP-1 axis. In vivo, administration of 8l at doses of 0.3 and 0.6 mg/kg significantly suppresses tumor growth in a PC-3 xenograft mouse model. Collectively, this study highlights the therapeutic potential of 8l as a colchicine-based anticancer agent, effectively attenuating tumor progression through modulation of the NRF-2/KEAP-1 axis.
abstract_zh: 秋水仙碱的非选择性毒性仍然是其作为抗癌药物开发的主要障碍。在此，我们报道了一种秋水仙碱衍生物8l，其在前列腺癌细胞中表现出强效且选择性的抗增殖活性。本研究探讨了C10位取代手性胺片段上的立体化学对生物活性的影响。我们的发现表明，8l的立体化学构型（7S,15R非对映异构体）对其疗效至关重要，其抗增殖活性比对应的7S,15S非对映异构体8z高出12.5倍。此外，与8z相比，8l表现出更优的α-微管蛋白聚合抑制作用，这一点通过对接和模拟研究得到了进一步证实。机制性见解表明，8l通过调节NRF-2/KEAP-1轴来增加活性氧水平。在体内，以0.3和0.6 mg/kg剂量给药8l可显著抑制PC-3异种移植小鼠模型中的肿瘤生长。总体而言，本研究强调了8l作为基于秋水仙碱的抗癌药物的治疗潜力，通过调节NRF-2/KEAP-1轴有效减缓肿瘤进展。
